title: token_audit: per-session token attribution and reporting
objective: Land the token_audit package so token spend in a Claude session can be traced to what caused it — a skill, a hook, an always-on rule file, or an image — turning 'the context is expensive' into a measurable, per-cause number that can be acted on.
acceptance_criteria: python_pkg/token_audit/ ships parse, model, attribute, imagecost, report and a __main__ CLI entry point
The full test suite passes: 81 tests, 0 failures
Branch coverage is 100% across all seven modules (the repo gate is fail_under = 100)
The repo pre-commit gate passes with no suppressions and no --no-verify
out_of_scope: poker-stakes/, its CI workflow, and its README row — a concurrent session's uncommitted work, deliberately not staged
Any change to existing python_pkg packages
verifier: python -m pytest python_pkg/token_audit/tests/ -q for correctness; python -m coverage run --branch --source=python_pkg/token_audit for the 100% branch-coverage bar; the repo pre-commit gate (ruff, mypy, pylint, bandit, coverage enforcement) as the final adjudicator.
